title: Helios Cloud Global Infrastructure
content:
Helios Cloud operates data centers in five regions: US East (Virginia), US West (Oregon), EU Central (Frankfurt), EU West (Dublin), and Asia Pacific (Singapore).

Customers choose a primary region when creating a project. Projects can be replicated to a second region on the Enterprise plan.

title: Helios Cloud Release Notes 4.2
content: Release 4.2 introduced a command line tool called helioctl for managing projects from a terminal. The release also added Terraform provider support and raised the maximum object size to 5 gigabytes.
